title: Algorithm: Network Firewall Packet Filter
description:
Real-World Algorithm: Network Security Firewall
Enterprise routers inspect inbound packet headers millions of times per second. If a packet matches a blocked IP address or malicious port, the packet is flagged.

The Challenge:
The network packet data below is locked. In the editable section, write an if statement: if port == 8080, print "BLOCKED: Insecure Port Detected".
